context: A boss announces an office relocation plan to his manager
purpose: Teach: 引越し/倉庫/拠点/敷地/保管/申告/在宅/移住

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実は来月、本社の引越しを正式に進めることになった。
lines.en: Actually, next month we'll officially proceed with the head office relocation.
lines.style: Authoritative announcement, measured pace, deliberate tone with weight

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ついにですか。新しい拠点はどちらに構える予定でしょうか。
lines.en: At last. Where are we planning to establish the new base?
lines.style: Polite surprise with respectful upward register and slight excitement

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 横浜だ。敷地が今より三倍広くて、駐車場も十分ある。
lines.en: Yokohama. The premises are three times larger, with ample parking.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery, confident, briefing-style cadence, tone matching the moment with quiet honesty

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: それは助かります。古い書類の保管場所にずっと困っていましたから。
lines.en: That's a relief. We've long struggled with storage for old documents.
lines.style: Genuine relief, conversational warmth, mid-level politeness

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うむ。隣接する倉庫も借りられるから、資料は全部そこに移す。
lines.en: Right. We can lease the adjacent warehouse, so all materials go there.
lines.style: Crisp executive tone, practical, slight nod of satisfaction

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 税務申告の関係で、住所変更の手続きも早めに動きます。
lines.en: I'll start the address change paperwork early, due to tax filing concerns.
lines.style: Diligent middle-manager mode, businesslike, anticipating logistics

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 頼む。それから、希望者には在宅勤務の継続も認める方針だ。
lines.en: Please do. Also, employees who wish may continue working from home.
lines.style: Considerate leadership tone, slightly softer, policy-explaining register

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ありがたいです。遠方へ移住した社員も安心できますね。
lines.en: How thoughtful. Even staff who relocated far away can feel reassured.
lines.style: Warm appreciation, sincere, slightly relieved sigh in voice
